name: identity_create_action_rules
description: Creates a webhook rule for event_type that posts to url, and returns the rule. The signing secret is shown once on the admin HTTP response and is masked in this result.

url.description: HTTPS webhook URL. Required when creating a rule.

name: identity_create_groups
description: Creates an empty manual group named display_name. Returns the new group.

name: identity_create_invitations
description: Invites email to the company, sends the invitation email, and returns the invitation. language is en or fr, and optional app_url is the link in that email.

app_url.description: App URL linked from the email. An http(s) origin must match the company redirect allowlist. A desktop app uses the exact custom-scheme URI from that allowlist. Omit to send the email without a link.

name: identity_create_oauth_clients
description: Links SocialApp social_app_id to the company as an OAuth client. Returns the new mapping.

name: identity_create_oauth_redirects
description: Adds base_url to the company redirect allowlist (source is manual or hosting) and returns the new redirect.

source.description: Who created the redirect: manual or hosting.

name: identity_create_oauth_social_apps
description: Creates an OAuth SocialApp for docs_slug (or provider) with client_id and client_secret, and returns the new key. The client secret is shown once on the admin HTTP response and is masked in this result.

docs_slug.description: Catalog provider slug, for example github.

provider.description: Same catalog slugs as docs_slug. Send one of the two.

name: identity_create_personal_access_tokens
description: Creates a personal access token with optional name and read_only, and returns its metadata. The token is shown once on the admin HTTP response and is masked in this result.

name: identity_create_scim_tokens
description: Creates a SCIM bearer token with optional name and returns its metadata. The secret is shown once on the admin HTTP response and is masked in this result.

name: identity_delete_action_rules
description: Deletes webhook rule id. Returns an empty success response.

name: identity_delete_groups
description: Deletes manual group id and refuses SCIM-managed groups. Returns an empty success response.

name: identity_delete_hosting_oauth_redirects
description: Deletes the hosting-managed redirect for base_url. Returns an empty success response.

base_url.description: Redirect origin to remove, including scheme and host.

name: identity_delete_invitations
description: Deletes revoked invitation id. Pending invitations must be revoked first, and a successful delete returns an empty response.

name: identity_delete_oauth_clients
description: Deletes OAuth client mapping id and leaves the SocialApp in place. Returns an empty success response.

name: identity_delete_oauth_redirects
description: Removes redirect id from the allowlist. Returns an empty success response.

name: identity_delete_oauth_social_apps
description: Deletes SocialApp id when no other company maps it and removing it would not lock out sign-in. Returns an empty success response.

name: identity_delete_users
description: Removes user id from the company and deletes the account when it was their last company. Returns an empty success response.

name: identity_get_action_deliveries
description: Reads the webhook delivery identified by delivery_id, including attempts and the event envelope. Returns that delivery.

name: identity_get_action_rules
description: Reads webhook rule id. Returns the rule metadata without the signing secret.

name: identity_get_auth_methods
description: Reads which sign-in methods are enabled, including magic link, OAuth, and SAML. Returns the company auth settings.

name: identity_get_companies
description: Reads company id, including name, owners, and join access. Returns the company settings.

name: identity_get_events
description: Reads event id. scope is company or platform (platform is staff only) and the result is the event payload.

scope.description: Event scope. company is the default. platform is staff only and returns 403 for other callers.

name: identity_get_events_retention
description: Reads how long identity events are kept and whether retention is stale. Returns the retention settings.

name: identity_get_groups
description: Reads company group id. Returns its metadata and member count.

name: identity_get_oauth_clients
description: Reads OAuth client mapping id. Returns the provider, SocialApp id, and active flag.

name: identity_get_oauth_provider_catalog
description: Reads the Shellui OAuth provider catalog, including callback URLs and setup fields, and returns it. Pass include_legacy to include replaced providers.

name: identity_get_oauth_redirects
description: Reads redirect id. Returns that allowlist row.

name: identity_get_scim_status
description: Reads whether SCIM provisioning is enabled and which base URL to use. Returns the SCIM status.

name: identity_get_users
description: Reads company user id. Returns the profile, membership, and groups.

name: identity_get_users_audience
description: Counts or lists company users matching roles, access, group_ids, and date filters, without sending email. Returns count and, unless count_only is true, a page of matches.

access.description: Membership filter. enabled is the default.

roles.description: Roles to match. One or more of owner, staff, or member.

name: identity_list_action_deliveries
description: Lists webhook deliveries. Filter with status, event_type, action_rule_id, or a created date range, and the result is a page of deliveries.

event_type.description: Webhook event type id to filter on.

name: identity_list_action_events
description: Lists identity events that can trigger an Actions webhook. Returns each event type and its payload fields.

name: identity_list_action_rules
description: Lists Actions webhook rules for the company. Returns each rule without its signing secret.

name: identity_list_companies
description: Lists companies where the caller is a member. Returns each company id and name.

name: identity_list_events
description: Lists identity audit events for the company. Filter with event_type, user_id, user, scope, or a created date range, and the result is a page of events.

event_type.description: Event type ids to include. One or more.

scope.description: Event scope. company is the default. platform is staff only and returns 403 for other callers.

name: identity_list_events_types
description: Lists identity event types stored in the company event log. Returns each type id, label, and whether it can trigger a webhook.

name: identity_list_groups
description: Lists manual and SCIM groups in the company. Returns each group and its member count.

name: identity_list_invitations
description: Lists pending invitations and revoked invitations that still block sign-in. Returns each invitation.

name: identity_list_oauth_clients
description: Lists the company OAuth client mappings. Returns provider, SocialApp id, and whether each mapping is active.

name: identity_list_oauth_redirects
description: Lists redirect URIs allowed for this company. Returns each allowlist row.

name: identity_list_oauth_social_apps
description: Lists OAuth SocialApp keys owned by the company. Returns client ids and providers, not client secrets.

name: identity_list_personal_access_tokens
description: Lists personal access tokens for the caller in this company. Returns token metadata, not the token itself.

name: identity_list_scim_tokens
description: Lists SCIM bearer tokens for the company. Returns token metadata, not the bearer secret.

name: identity_list_services
description: Lists Shellui service MCP endpoints connected for this company. Returns each service id and URL.

name: identity_list_users
description: Lists users in the company, with optional q search and page or page_size. Returns a page of profiles.

name: identity_replace_auth_methods
description: Replaces company auth settings, including enable_magic_link. Returns the auth settings.

enable_magic_link.description: Whether email magic-link sign-in is enabled for this company.

name: identity_replace_companies
description: Replaces company id settings such as name, owner_ids, access_mode, and desktop redirect schemes. Returns the updated company.

access_mode.description: How people join the company: public, domain, or invite.

name: identity_replace_groups
description: Replaces the display name of manual group id. Returns the updated group.

name: identity_replace_hosting_oauth_redirects
description: Replaces hosting-managed redirect URIs with base_url. Returns the synced redirect.

base_url.description: Redirect origin to sync, including scheme and host.

name: identity_replace_oauth_clients
description: Updates OAuth client mapping id, including is_active or social_app_id. Returns the updated mapping.

name: identity_replace_oauth_social_apps
description: Updates SocialApp id (client_id, client_secret, tenant, or extra_settings) and returns the updated key. A new client secret is masked in this result.

name: identity_replace_users
description: Updates company user id: name, enabled state, manual groups, or metadata. Returns the updated user.

name: identity_requeue_action_deliveries
description: Queues failed delivery delivery_id again so it is sent to the rule URL. Returns the updated delivery.

name: identity_revoke_invitations
description: Revokes pending invitation id so it cannot be accepted. Returns the revoked invitation.

name: identity_revoke_personal_access_tokens
description: Revokes the personal access token identified by key_id. Returns the revoked token.

name: identity_revoke_scim_tokens
description: Revokes the SCIM bearer token identified by token_id. Returns the revoked token.

name: identity_rotate_rule_secret
description: Rotates the signing secret for webhook rule id and returns the rule. The new secret is shown once on the admin HTTP response and is masked in this result.

name: identity_send_test_rule
description: Sends a synthetic webhook for rule id to its URL. Returns the delivery result.

name: identity_update_action_rules
description: Updates webhook rule id, including url, enabled, event_type, or the request headers. Returns the updated rule.

name: identity_update_auth_methods
description: Updates enable_magic_link for the company. Returns the auth settings.

enable_magic_link.description: Whether email magic-link sign-in is enabled for this company.

name: identity_update_companies
description: Updates company id settings such as name, owner_ids, access_mode, and desktop redirect schemes. Returns the updated company.

access_mode.description: How people join the company: public, domain, or invite.

name: identity_update_groups
description: Updates the display name of manual group id. Returns the updated group.

name: identity_update_oauth_redirects
description: Updates redirect id: base_url, label, or is_active. Returns the updated row.

base_url.description: Required when label and is_active are omitted.

label.description: Required when base_url and is_active are omitted.

is_active.description: Required when base_url and label are omitted.
